title: Descendant Replay
description: The ultimate quality of life data pack for Descendant by gerg!
body:
# Description
Adds infinite replayability to Descendant, a roguelike made by gerg!

Loot and shop items run out after playing enough, which basically forces you to delete the world and redownload it. And there are weird bugs that can break the experience for some reason!

This data pack aims to fix these issues so that you can use the same world infinitely, without messing up all the cool redstone. It also adds some other quality of life improvements fit for a true gamer.

### Everything it does:
- Prevents loot from running out due to extreme greed
- Prevents shop items from running out due to gambling addiction
- Keeps class items stocked infinitely
- Empties containers that store garbage items so they don't overflow
- Refills dispensers that probably weren't gonna run out any time soon, just for the sake of infinite replay!!
- Fixes the lava jumps on floor 3 when they break after you inevitably die from them
- Prevents the allays inside The Weather from dying somehow! Seriously, how are they dying??
- Makes it so you only need to press the genocide button once! And when you do, it brings up a prompt to speed up the tick rate instead of typing the command yourself! Can we get much lazier?
- Makes Loot Storage Crates placeable even in adventure mode! Now you don't have to accidentally break blocks in survival mode
- Adds a button to erase data so you can start a completely new game! Perfect for pretending like you never died and lost all your armor, key pieces, and storage crates.
- And more! ...Ok I lied, there isn't more.

## Before You Install
Because of the way this data pack was made, it won't fully work if you add it to a world where you've already started a run before. Please add this data pack to a fresh copy of Descendant.

## How to Install
Open your Descendant world folder, open the "datapacks" folder, and move the downloaded file there.

# Descendant
Descendant is a roguelike world made by YouTuber gerg. Learn more here: [https://www.youtube.com/@_gerg](https://www.youtube.com/@_gerg)

Download it on gerg's Discord server: [https://discord.gg/ujnSgv6PCC](https://discord.gg/ujnSgv6PCC)
